protocol.action: Existing native compiled corrected Taylor and cdist64/gram64 generators; combined Gram/output Taylor tiles share128KiB.
protocol.order: For each observed degree, five cyclic repetitions of select/Taylor/cdist64/gram64; offset varies with degree and dataset.
protocol.vector: Prepared alpha_reference at lambda.001 for standalone actions and selector-cost estimates.
protocol.selection: Existing lean binary search0..40; threshold is midpoint of current standalone vector bounds at q and q−1, asserted to returnq.
protocol.gaussian_price: Per dataset, median pooled observations for each Gaussian mode; exact actions use faster mode, literal verification uses cdist64.
protocol.weighting: Frozen actual diagnostic degree histograms. Selector estimate charged only to adaptive; static controls have none.
protocol.excluded: No solver rerun. Setup, degree initialization, preconditioning, dot products/vector work, allocator effects of a whole solver, and unmeasured actual-search-direction effects are excluded.
protocol.fairness: Fixed controls stopped at recursive0.5tol; adaptive stopped at recursive+bound<=tol. This gives adaptive an iteration-count advantage; every frozen run passed finaltol.
protocol.scope: Standalone action-plus-selector cost estimates, not actual selector runtimes along CG, total-memory compliance, or end-to-end speedups.
